dog.description_text: Loki is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! Loki, a five-year-old male, just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQDQKuVvbNcTTJm3Tsk_RaXTAcKETwf6ax_RUE1W-W7sDLU?e=CMm4aH Loki is very sweet. He is friendly and loves to be pet and likes to 'chat'. His foster says "Loki is so sweet. He can be nervous at first when you meet him and can take a little bit to trust you but once he does, he’s a secret softie. He loves the snuggle close to both his foster mom and dad. He’s funny and loves to play! He’s also very curious! He loves looking at birds out the window and is very happy whenever there’s cat TV on. Every day he’s gotten more comfortable and happy with us. He just started playing this week and made his first biscuits two days ago. He consistently sleeps a lot. He’s super curious - loves looking out windows and watching cat TV. He’s been through a lot of transition. You can tell he’s so loving and wants to be the center of our attention but just takes patience and trust building to warm up! He loves cuddling near us on the couch when we’re watching TV and will jump up on the desk when we’re working if he wants attention. From the beginning Loki was curious, engaged with the household; over time he's become friendlier and loves a comfy lap. He also likes "his spot" - a shelf with a towel that he sleeps on." He likes to cuddle and is affectionate. She loves his cute sound when I pet him is the top joy. Also he likes napping close to people. I really love the way he leans against me and rests his body on my leg or gently lays his head on my lap." He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
